ios.desc:
Talk instead of type, and never take notes again. DictaWiz is your agentic AI keyboard and notes manager: voice becomes clean text in any app, and every recording becomes an organized, searchable note. Every AI model runs on your device, so your voice never leaves your phone.

STOP TYPING, START TALKING
Speak naturally and get polished text back. DictaWiz cleans up grammar, punctuation, and formatting as you talk, so nobody can tell you dictated it. Works in Messages, Notes, Mail, and every other app on your phone. Pick from 16 keyboard layouts, including QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY, and Cyrillic.

AN AGENTIC AI KEYBOARD
Tap AI Skills for dozens of built-in shortcuts: fix grammar, insert a map link, add a calendar event, draft a reply, get a quick answer, and more. Don't see what you need? Describe any skill and DictaWiz builds it. Chain skills together to run automatically after you dictate, so one recording triggers a whole sequence of actions.

WORKS ANYWHERE, IN ANY LANGUAGE
Dictate on a plane, in a tunnel, or anywhere with no signal at all. 25 languages with the fast engine, 99+ with the comprehensive one, all running locally on your iPhone. Auto-detect your language, or pick it yourself. Translate any language to English, on your device.

NEVER TAKE NOTES AGAIN
Record a meeting, lecture, or interview and get the transcript written for you, with each speaker labeled. AI writes the summary: key points, decisions, and action items, done automatically. Watch it fill in live as you record. Import an audio file or a URL if you already have one.

TURN ANY RECORDING INTO STUDY MATERIAL
Get flashcards, a quiz, or a mind map from any recording, ready to study right away. Canvas turns the transcript into an editable notes document: lists, callouts, and key points you can edit and save.

AN AI ASSISTANT FOR ANY TEXT
Copy any text, tap the AI key, and type what you want done: reply to an email, rewrite a paragraph, answer a question.

STOP CORRECTING THE SAME WORDS
Set up abbreviations that expand as you type, perfect for medical terms, legal phrases, or anything you type often, and fix names DictaWiz never quite gets right.

START RECORDING IN ONE TAP
Add a home screen widget to start recording instantly. Ask Siri to record and get a transcript without opening the app. A Live Activity keeps you posted from the lock screen and Dynamic Island.

YOUR NOTES, WHEREVER YOU WORK
Send transcripts straight to Obsidian, Notion, Bear, or Drafts, or any app that takes a webhook.

Record and transcribe anything, replay with word-by-word highlighting, and dictate/use AI into any app; all on-device and private.

Includes a lot of features missing in Wispr Flow (Apple Watch recording, dark mode, no time-limits, smart notes and lifetime subscription plan). It has a lifetime subscription and upcoming MacOS companion.
